name: J. R. Widmyer
bio: J. R. Widmyer of the Glendive Independent visited the Cow Boy in September 1884, and in February 1886 the paper mocked the poetry in his paper's railroad column. In April 1886 he attended the Little Missouri stockgrowers' meeting with other newspapermen.

moments.label: Attended the stockgrowers' meeting as a newspaperman

mentions: J. R. Widmyer, of the Glendive Independent, made us a pleasant visit last Sunday.
…noffending public, those in the railroad column of the Glendive Independent are the chief. For Heaven's sake, Widmyer, let up!
Meeting of the Little Missouri River Stockgrowers' Association.
…ssrs. Marney of the Stockgrowers' Journal, Knight of the Yellowstone Journal, Mabee of the Glendive Times and Widmyer of the Independent, were present.
